roadmap.title: Story + side content as it appears
roadmap.text: Play the five story chapters and take optional missions and character quests as they appear. Scan new vehicles with WAiNK, study animals with binoculars, and do Lucia's balcony meditation in Chapter 1 — the one thing that can slip away. Keep a manual save at the start and end of every chapter: there is no mission replay.

roadmap.title: 100% Completion Checklist + 70 of 80 Challenges
roadmap.text: After the credits, Progress > Stats gains the 100% Completion checklist. Work through robberies, collectibles, races, shooting ranges, drone races and Bret's Target Decks. The checklist is forgiving — closer to 60% true completion — and you only need 70 of the 80 Challenges, so skip the hardest ten.

roadmap.title: Strangers & Freaks + cleanup
roadmap.text: The checklist does not ask for Strangers & Freaks, so they are usually what is left: finish the eight qualifying strands, mop up any character questlines and stray miscellaneous trophies, and the platinum pops.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum is the last trophy you earn: it pops the moment the other 54 are done. No online play and no DLC is needed — the whole list is single-player, so the roadmap below is the whole job.

steps.t: Work the roadmap in order: story first, then the 100% checklist, then Strangers & Freaks cleanup.
Do Lucia's balcony meditation in Chapter 1 — the only trophy that can slip away.
Track everything in this guide's checklist; the platinum pops automatically once 54 of 54 show earned.

claims.t: The platinum needs all 54 other trophies and nothing else.
No multiplayer or DLC trophy exists: all 55 are single-player and offline.
PowerPyx rates the whole platinum 4 out of 10 for difficulty.
Time estimates run about 200 hours on PowerPyx, KeenGamer and GTABase — Push Square says 300 hours or more.
One playthrough is enough; there is no New Game+ and no mission replay.
Free roam continues after the story, so cleanup happens after the credits.
The hardest single trophy is A Long Road (100% completion), per PowerPyx and KeenGamer.
games.gg: 55 base-game trophies, split into 27 non-hidden and 28 hidden entries; every trophy is offline.
games.gg: 15 manual save slots and one autosave, with no mission replay.
GamesFuze cross-checks its list against multiple published sources and last reviewed it 19 Nov 2026.

disputes.topic: How long is the platinum?
disputes.a: PowerPyx, KeenGamer and GTABase put it at about 200 hours.
disputes.b: Push Square says to expect 300 hours or more.
disputes.call: Plan for 200 hours of focused play; Push Square's 300 covers a slower, explore-everything pace.

disputes.topic: Cheats: what do they cost you, and when?
disputes.a: PowerPyx: cheats disable trophies and saving.
disputes.b: gamemapa: cheats only unlock after the story — exactly when the trophy cleanup happens.
disputes.call: Keep cheats off the save you are using for the platinum, full stop.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% on the in-game completion checklist (Progress > Stats > 100% Completion), which unlocks after the story. The checklist is forgiving: most things are only partly required, and you need just 70 of the 80 Challenges. Everything on it can still be done after the story in free roam.

steps.t: Finish the story; the checklist appears under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion.
Clear every robbery line first: 39 gang operations, 22 bank jobs, 7 payday loan jobs, 8 bank vaults.
Work the collectibles to their partial targets (200/277 vehicles, 100/255 animals, 15/18 card sets, 100 WAiNK scans).
Finish activities to their targets (42 shooting range golds, 42 drone time trials, 300 stunts, 15 Target Decks).
Complete any 70 of the 80 Challenges — skip the ten hardest.

claims.t: The 100% checklist unlocks after the story under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion.
Progress made during the story already counts toward the checklist.
Nothing else you can miss affects trophies: every trophy-related task is still doable after the story in free roam.
PowerPyx calls it closer to 60% true completion — most side quests are not required at all.
Push Square says the opposite in tone: you have to do almost everything for 100%.
Robberies for 100%: 39 of 39 gang operations and 8 of 8 bank vaults.
Robberies for 100%: 22 of 22 bank jobs and 7 of 7 payday loan jobs.
Also required: 34 of 35 Smash 'N' Grabs and 50 of 91 Stick Ups.
Fencing for 100%: $250,000 in marked bills.
Fencing for 100%: $100,000 narcotics, $100,000 jewelry and $200,000 vehicles.
Collectibles for 100%: 200 of 277 base-model vehicles, 100 of 255 animals studied.
Collectibles for 100%: 15 of 18 card sets, 100 WAiNK scans, 33 of 33 underwater discoveries.
Collectibles for 100%: 5 of 7 Kenton treasure sets, 30 of 34 magazines/books/comics, 100 of 125 Cocaine Flamingos.
Collectibles for 100%: 2 of 2 unique playlists, 70 of 79 discovered styles, 50 of 66 standard-issue weapons.
Meditations for 100%: only 15 of 18 — the trophy itself needs all 18.
Activities for 100%: 42 of 42 shooting range golds, 42 of 42 drone time trials, 300 of 397 stunts.
Activities for 100%: 15 of 15 Bret Target Decks.
Activities for 100%: 30 of 40 races won and 10 of 13 race challenge golds.
Activities for 100%: play all 4 video games, beat 5 of 7 pool opponents, mini golf at 2 of 3 spots, 90 of 100 basketball hoops.
Challenges for 100%: any 70 of 80 — ten can be skipped.
Optional missions for 100%: any 100 completed; there are far more than 100 in the game.
The only tasks that require everything are robberies, underwater discoveries, shooting ranges, drone races and Bret's quests.
games.gg’s threshold table: stunts 250 vs 300 for 100%, challenges 50 vs 70, vehicles 100 vs 200 scanned, vaults 5 vs 8, gang operations 1-per-gang vs all 39.

disputes.topic: How much of the game is 100%?
disputes.a: PowerPyx: the checklist is closer to 60% true completion; most side quests and collectibles are only partly required.
disputes.b: Push Square: you have to do almost everything to reach 100%.
disputes.call: PowerPyx's numbers win: the checklist itself lists partial targets (200 of 277 vehicles, 15 of 18 card sets, 70 of 80 challenges), so 'almost everything' is the wrong read.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete any 250 of the 397 stunts across Leonida. Mix the four categories and pick the easiest: Under the Bridges flights are the quickest. For 100% you need 300, so this pops on the way.

steps.t: Do stunts in any mix of the four categories until 250 are done.
Prioritise Under the Bridges flights — the quickest category.
Track progress by region under Progress > Activities > Stunts, or on the map under Exploration > Stunt Spots.

claims.t: Any 250 of the 397 stunts count; the categories can be mixed.
The four categories: 130 Stunt Jumps, 202 Under the Bridges, 40 Knife Flights, 25 Base Jumps.
For 100% completion you need 300 stunts, so this trophy pops on the way there.
Under the Bridges are the quickest stunts to do, per PowerPyx.
Stunt challenges shown on map icons are not required — performing the stunt once counts as completed.
Stunts stay marked on the map after completing them and each has a unique name.
Progress can be tracked by region in Progress > Activities > Stunts.
The trophy list itself tracks total stunt progress.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the nine activity types at least once. You will be introduced to most of them through the story, and the rest are marked with blue icons when you unfog the map. You will almost certainly finish this while working on other trophies.

steps.t: Do one of each of the nine activity types listed in Progress > Activities.
Filter the map for Activities (blue dumbbell icon) to find the ones you have not tried.

claims.t: The trophy tracker counts nine types of activities.
The nine types: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball, playing a video game, winning a race, performing a stunt.
Activities are shown in Progress > Activities with a count of how many you have done.
Most types are introduced automatically by the main story.
The rest get marked with blue icons when you unfog the map.
You will do one of each automatically while working on other trophies and the 100% checklist.

steps.t: Visit the shooting ranges and work through all 42 challenges to gold.
Some challenges are locked until you meet other conditions — check the map for requirements.
Track progress under Progress > Activities > Shooting Ranges.

All 42 are also required for the 100% checklist — no skipping here.

Push Square lists only two shooting range locations: Rodgers Ranch & Shooting Range (Port Gellhorn) and Griffin Shooting Range (Balsero).

Shooting range progress is tracked under Progress > Activities > Shooting Ranges.

disputes.topic: How many shooting range locations are there?
disputes.a: PowerPyx: 12 shooting range locations holding the 42 challenges.
disputes.b: Push Square: two shooting range locations — Rodgers Ranch (Port Gellhorn) and Griffin (Balsero).
disputes.call: The 42 challenges are agreed by all three sources; treat the location count as unsettled and follow the in-game Activities list, which names the ranges.

steps.t: Win one Top Fun drone race at each of the 14 locations.

Find locations on the map under Activities > Drones > Top Fun Drones.

claims.t: There are 14 Top Fun drone race locations.

steps.t: Pick any of the four video games and finish all of its levels once.
The first three games are on the TV at home — interact with the controllers.
Bang For Your Buck is found at arcade machines around the world.

claims.t: There are four arcade games, called Video Games in-game.
The four games: Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III, Time Jackers Rewind, Bang For Your Buck.
The first three are playable at the TV in your home from Chapter 1.
Bang For Your Buck is found at arcade machines throughout the world.
To complete a game you must finish all levels in it at least once.
You do not need to beat all challenges — just reach the end of a game.
For 100% completion you must play all four video games (not finish all four).

disputes.topic: Which arcade games count?
disputes.a: PowerPyx names all four: Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III, Time Jackers Rewind, Bang For Your Buck.
disputes.b: KeenGamer just says complete any one arcade game.
disputes.call: Any one of the four counts; PowerPyx’s list is the only published roster.

Confirmed to count: Kirk (Skunk Ape / Mr. Mangrove), Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete.
Kirk's strand: Search for the Skunk Ape, Search for Tree Effigies, Help Kirk Find Mr. Mangrove.
Kyle's strand: Check Out McKittrick Farm, Collect Chemicals for Kyle, Buddy? (Check on Kyle).
Yago's strand: Join a Street Race, Bumper to Bumper, Race Against Yago, Brother to Brother.
Pilot Pete's strand: The Last Mile (Passing the Torch and Backseat Pilot) plus his deliveries.
PowerPyx: Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie do NOT count toward this trophy.
KeenGamer does not name which strands count — it just says eight qualifying strands.
Strangers & Freaks are still there after the story in free roam.
Strangers & Freaks are NOT required for the 100% checklist, so they are usually left for stage 3.
games.gg: Andy, Billy and Tyrone’s optional questlines do not count toward this trophy — use the trophy tracker to count completed stranger strands.

disputes.topic: Which stranger strands count?
disputes.a: PowerPyx names four confirmed strands (Kirk, Kyle, Yago, Pilot Pete) and six questlines that do not count (Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy, Eddie).
disputes.b: KeenGamer says only 'eight qualifying Stranger mission strands' and names none.
disputes.call: Follow PowerPyx's confirmed list and avoid the six excluded questlines; more strands are still being discovered.

disputes.topic: How long is the stage 3 cleanup?
disputes.a: PowerPyx: 10 hours.
disputes.b: KeenGamer: 10–20 hours.
disputes.call: Budget 10–20 hours; it runs long if you did little side content during the story.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Deliver all 16 cars on Randy's Wish List. It starts in Chapter 3 after the mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS, where you steal the Zorrusso for Randy and unlock the Key Cloner. Scan high-end sports cars with WAiNK to check them against the list, then drive them to his garage in west Vice City.

steps.t: In Chapter 3, finish Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS and deliver the Zorrusso to Randy.
Scan high-end sports cars with WAiNK to see if they are on the wish list.
Drive each wanted car to Randy's garage (green RK icon, west Vice City) in good condition for more pay.
Work through the cars he marks on the map; he marks new ones as you complete them.

claims.t: Randy's wish list starts in Chapter 3 after Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS.
The Key Cloner is unlocked during that mission to break into high-end sports cars.
The list has 16 sports cars, including the Zorrusso delivered during the story mission.
Cars on the list include the Pegassi Vitello, Infernus, Toros and Tempesta, and the Grotti Itali RSX.
Randy is marked by the green RK icon in the west of Vice City.
Track the list under Map > Robberies > Randy's Wish List.
High-end sports cars are often found in east Vice City at Vice Beach / Ocean Beach, parked outside hotels.
Delivering a car in good condition pays more.
This can still be done after the story.
Push Square confirms the trophy unlocks after completing all of Randy's missions.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's questline, ending with the mission Spin On This. It opens after the Chapter 3 mission Here, Kitty Kitty and is Jason-only: destroy the Synthetic Labs marked in Vice City, then Tyrone gives you the final quest. All of it stays available after the story.

steps.t: As Jason, after Chapter 3's Here, Kitty Kitty, follow the purple markers to the Synthetic Labs.
Destroy the labs in the Take Out Kitty Litter quest.
Take Tyrone's second quest, Spin On This, and shut down the labs to pop the trophy.

claims.t: Tyrone's questline opens after the Chapter 3 mission Here, Kitty Kitty.
It is only available as Jason, not as Lucia.
The labs are marked with purple map markers in Vice City.
The first quest is Take Out Kitty Litter (Kitty Litter Labs).
The final quest is Spin On This (shut down the labs).
All of it is still available after the story.
Push Square confirms the trophy unlocks after completing all of Tyrone's missions.
gamemapa: destroy the labs and finish Tyrone's last quest; Jason only, from Chapter 3.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots across Leonida. THE missable trophy: the first meditation, with Lucia on the balcony at Jason's house in Chapter 1, becomes permanently unavailable after Chapter 1 — and it is still unconfirmed whether the trophy needs it. Do it anyway: after the Down to Earth mission, talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning, follow her to the balcony and choose Accept.

steps.t: CHAPTER 1 ONLY: after Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning and accept her meditation on the balcony.
Meditate at each of the 18 spots; meditating with both Jason and Lucia at a spot counts +2.
You cannot do the final meditation until both characters can play together (after Chapter 2's Coffee Break).
Track progress under Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations.

claims.t: There are 18 meditation spots across 10 different locations.
Meditating with both Jason and Lucia at one spot counts as +2 meditations.
The Chapter 1 balcony meditation is only available during Chapter 1 and becomes permanently unavailable after it.
The balcony meditation raises the counter by 1 but is not marked as a Meditation Spot like the rest.
PowerPyx: it is currently unclear whether the Chapter 1 meditation is required for the trophy.
gamemapa repeats the warning: PowerPyx has not confirmed whether the trophy needs it.
For the 100% checklist you only need 15 of 18 meditations.
The final meditation needs both characters together, unlocked after Chapter 2's Coffee Break.
Push Square: a meditation is not marked complete until a final 'zen' animation has played.
Progress is tracked under Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations.
This is the only potentially missable trophy in the game, per PowerPyx, KeenGamer and GTABase.
games.gg repeats the warning: whether the Chapter 1 meditation is required remains unconfirmed.

disputes.topic: Is the Chapter 1 balcony meditation required?
disputes.a: PowerPyx: the counter goes up by 1, but the balcony is not marked as a Meditation Spot, so it is unclear whether the trophy needs it.
disputes.b: gamemapa: same — PowerPyx has not confirmed whether the trophy needs it.
disputes.call: Do it anyway in Chapter 1. It costs a minute, and if it is required there is no second chance.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret Vogel. His questline opens after Chapter 2's Coffee Break — as Jason you get a text marking Veteran Hunted in Lummox County. Bret then marks hunting spots; bring the animals back to him. Which exact animal pops the trophy is still being confirmed, so work the whole questline.

steps.t: After Chapter 2's Coffee Break, as Jason, take Bret's text and meet him (Veteran Hunted, Lummox County).
Hunt the animals Bret marks on the map and bring them back to him.
Use the Killtelligence SM-69 hunting rifle Bret gives you; one clean shot keeps the animal pristine and pays more.

claims.t: Bret's questline opens after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break.
It is exclusive to Jason — Lucia cannot receive Bret's text.
The first quest is Veteran Hunted (meet Bret) in Lummox County.
Bret marks hunting spots with purple icons on the map.
Bret gives you the unique hunting rifle Killtelligence SM-69 in the first quest.
The rifle can be retrieved from any weapon locker at Ammu-Nations.
PowerPyx: it is still undergoing confirmation which animal exactly unlocks this trophy.
Track the hunts under Map > Activities > Target Deck; there are 15 Target Decks total.
All 15 Target Decks are required for the 100% checklist.
gamemapa: hunt a unique animal for Bret; Jason only, the exact animal is still being confirmed.

disputes.topic: Which animal pops Fair Game?
disputes.a: PowerPyx: still undergoing confirmation which animal exactly unlocks this.
disputes.b: KeenGamer and gamemapa give no animal either — KeenGamer just says 'hunt a unique animal for Bret'.
disputes.call: Work Bret's whole questline rather than hunting one guessed animal; the trigger animal is unconfirmed as of 21 Nov 2026.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete any three Collectible Card sets. There are 18 sets in total, and 100% needs 15 of them, so this pops early in the cleanup. Cards you sell at Pawn Shops still count toward progress.

steps.t: Collect cards until three full sets are complete.
Track sets under Progress > Collections > Collectible Cards.
Sell spare cards at Pawn Shops — sold cards still count.

claims.t: Three full Collectible Card sets must be completed.
There are 18 card sets in total.
For 100% completion, 15 of the 18 sets are required.
Cards can be sold at Pawn Shops and still contribute toward progress.
Progress is tracked under Progress > Collections > Collectible Cards.
PowerPyx links a guide to all 18 card set locations.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Scan 100 locations with the WAiNK app — landmarks, curiosities, sculptures and No Flusher tags. Hold Up to open WAiNK instantly, look at an object and hold R1 to scan. Any 100 count, and 100 scans are also required for 100%.

steps.t: Hold Up to open WAiNK, look at a scannable object and hold R1 to scan it.
Scan any mix of landmarks, curiosities, sculptures and No Flusher tags until 100 are done.
Track progress under Progress > Collections > WAiNK Locations.

claims.t: 100 WAiNK scans are required; any mix of the four types counts.
The breakdown: 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities, 23 sculptures, plus No Flusher tags.
WAiNK is opened instantly by holding Up, without selecting it from the phone.
Scanning is done by holding R1 while looking at an object.
100 WAiNK scans are also required for the 100% checklist.
Scanning vehicles with WAiNK also discovers them for Whip It Good.
Progress is tracked under Progress > Collections > WAiNK Locations.
WAiNK scanning is introduced automatically in Chapter 1.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete any 50 of the 80 Challenges. You will finish most of them naturally while working on other trophies; 100% needs 70, so this pops on the way. Save the easiest ten for last if you are short.

steps.t: Work on other trophies — most challenges complete naturally along the way.
Check Progress > Challenges for what is left and pick the easiest remaining ones.
Complete any 50 of the 80; ten can be skipped entirely.

claims.t: There are 80 Challenges in total; any 50 count for this trophy.
For 100% completion, any 70 of the 80 are required.
Ten challenges can be skipped for both the trophy and 100%.
Challenges are viewed and tracked under Progress > Challenges.
A completed challenge shows a checkmark in the bottom right when you scroll over it.
Many challenges complete naturally while working on other trophies.
Push Square: Challenges are in-game achievements that require skillful gameplay.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star wanted level with your partner beside you and escape the heat. Earliest chance is after Chapter 2's Coffee Break, when you can roam together. Easiest route: the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County — cops struggle on the tracks and the helicopter loses you. It also pops by itself during bank vault robberies.

steps.t: After Chapter 2's Coffee Break, call your partner (hold Right + Triangle).
Raise a 4-star wanted level, then escape through the train tunnel north of Ambrosia.
The trophy pops after you leave the red heat zone — not just the flashing search area.

claims.t: Earliest chance is after Chapter 2's Coffee Break, when you can free-roam together.
Your partner is called by holding Right and pressing Triangle.
A 4-star wanted level is easy to reach — cause carnage until it hits four stars.
Easiest escape: the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County.
In the tunnel, cops struggle to follow on the tracks and the helicopter cannot see you.
The trophy unlocks after you drive out of the red heat zone, not the flashing search area.
It pops automatically during the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is…, which gives 4-star heat.
Robbing a large bank vault instantly gives a 4-star wanted level, so it often pops by itself.
A fast sports motorcycle helps cut through traffic to escape the search area.
If a helicopter chases you, shoot at it until it goes away.
games.gg: clearing the flashing search area is not enough — Hot Together needs the red heat zone escaped too; the train tunnel north of Ambrosia gives cover from helicopters.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob three shops in a row with your partner while staying wanted the whole time. Do it after Chapter 2's Coffee Break. A good spot is the three jewelry stores in the north of Vice City (after Chapter 3's Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs). The pop is delayed about half a minute after leaving the third shop — if it does not pop, hit a fourth.

steps.t: After Chapter 2's Coffee Break, call your partner (hold Right + Triangle).
Hit three robbery targets (green map icons) in a row while staying wanted.
Rob a couple of items in each store and break the back-room safe with sticky bombs.
Wait about half a minute after the third shop — the pop is delayed; hit a fourth shop if it does not come.

claims.t: Only possible after Chapter 2's Coffee Break, when you can switch between both characters.
Three shops must be robbed back-to-back while keeping the wanted level.
Keep the red/blue flashing wanted level, not the red heat level.
A good spot is the three jewelry stores in the north of Vice City.
The jewelry stores are available after Chapter 3's Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs.
Rob a couple of items in each store and break the back-room safe with sticky bombs.
The trophy pop is delayed about half a minute after leaving the third shop.
If it does not pop after the third shop, hit a fourth and keep going.
Equip an armored vest and sticky bombs (Ammu-Nation) plus Zombix/Adrenaline for healing.
If you leave the first store before police arrive, you may need a fourth shop.
games.gg: Retail Therapy uses the opposite approach — keep the red-and-blue flashing pursuit active between shops; it can pop roughly 30 seconds after leaving the final shop.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Scanning a vehicle with WAiNK is enough — you do not need to drive it. Stand on a busy road and scan everything passing by. There are 557 vehicles at launch, and 100% needs 200 base-model scans, so this pops on the way.

steps.t: Open WAiNK (hold Up) and scan vehicles as they pass — scanning is enough, no driving needed.
Stand on a busy road and scan every new unique vehicle.
Check totals under Progress > Vehicles, by category.

claims.t: 100 vehicles must be discovered; a WAiNK scan is enough.
You do not need to drive a vehicle to discover it.
GTA VI has 557 vehicles at launch (cars, bikes, boats, helicopters, planes).
For 100% completion you must scan 200 of the 277 base-model vehicles.
Scanning also counts boats and aircraft.
Discovered vehicles are tracked under Progress > Vehicles, with totals by category.
Push Square: you also discover a vehicle automatically when you get inside one.
Start scanning early and it finishes naturally during the story.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down five enemies in a single use of Combat Focus (L3 + R3 while aiming). It only lasts a few seconds, so buff Focus first with food, drinks or a shower, take Adrenaline to extend it, and use an assault rifle like the Duke 556 on gang members at illegal operations. It does not seem to work on soldiers, police or civilians.

steps.t: Buff Focus with food/drinks or a shower, and take Adrenaline to extend Combat Focus.
Line up five gang enemies at an illegal operation with an assault rifle.
Activate Combat Focus (L3 + R3 while aiming) and drop all five before it ends.
Wear body armor so you can step out of cover and get close.

claims.t: Five enemies must be taken down in a single use of Combat Focus.
Combat Focus is activated with L3 + R3 while aiming a firearm.
It slows time, highlights vulnerable spots and drains the purple focus bar.
Focus lasts only a few seconds per use.
Adrenaline extends Combat Focus (hold L1, press Triangle).
PowerPyx: the trophy does not seem to work on soldiers, police or civilians — use gang members at illegal operations.
An assault rifle like the Duke 556 is more accurate than pistols and SMGs and shoots full-auto.
There are four Focus levels; Focus rises by playing shooting ranges, golf, pool, fishing and headshots.
Check Focus under Touchpad > Jason & Lucia > select character > Focus (purple eye icon).
It gets easier late in the game at Focus Level 4 and may pop naturally.
games.gg: press L3 + R3 while aiming to activate Combat Focus; Adrenaline extends it and an assault rifle helps against a clustered group of gang enemies.

disputes.topic: Who counts as an enemy for Gunslinger?
disputes.a: PowerPyx: it does not seem to work on soldiers, police or civilians — use gang members at illegal operations.
disputes.b: KeenGamer just says take down five enemies, with no restriction named.
disputes.call: Use gang members at illegal operations — the only target type all the advice agrees on.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal a large passenger plane docked at a departure terminal at VCIA (Vice City International Airport) and fly away. The easiest is the plane at terminals E3/E4: drive through a fence, climb the stairs by the boarding bridge, enter the cockpit, reverse to the strip and take off. Fly 1 km away and it pops.

steps.t: Go to VCIA and head for the airliner docked at departure terminals E3/E4.
Enter through the stairs by the boarding bridge, go upstairs and into the cockpit.
Drive the plane backward to the airstrip, take off and fly at least 1 km from the airport.

claims.t: You must steal a large passenger plane docked to a departure terminal at VCIA.
Planes sitting on the airfield do not work — it must be connected to a boarding bridge.
The easiest plane is the one at departure terminals E3/E4.
Drive through a fence around the airfield and head straight for the plane.
Stairs with a door next to the boarding bridge lead directly into the plane.
Inside, go upstairs, enter the cockpit, drive backward to the airstrip and take off.
The trophy unlock is delayed: you must fly 1 km (0.6 miles) away from the airport.
You can also enter on foot through the airport terminal, but the airfield route is faster.
KeenGamer: steal a departing passenger aircraft from Vice City International Airport.
games.gg: the plane at terminals E3/E4 is a suitable choice; fly about 1 km away from the airport for the delayed unlock.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Steal a military tank (a Rhino) at Mile Zero Air Station, the island on the south-west edge of the map in Mariana County. The tanks stand in the south of the air base — drive through the gate or take the stunt jump by the south-east entrance, get in a tank and shoot enemies until it pops.

steps.t: Go to Mile Zero Air Station on the south-west island (Mariana County).
Enter the base through the gate or the stunt jump by the south-east entrance.
Get into a tank in the south of the base and shoot enemies until the trophy pops.

claims.t: The trophy is unlocked by stealing a military tank.
Tanks are found at Mile Zero Air Station, the island on the south-west edge of the map.
The base is in Mariana County.
The tanks stand in the south of the air base.
Enter through the gate or the stunt jump next to the south-east entrance.
Shoot enemies from the tank until the trophy unlocks.
KeenGamer: steal a Rhino military tank and use it in combat.
gamemapa: steal a tank at Mile Zero Air Station.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. First finish Chapter 3's Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs — that unlocks the Snap Gun, which silently lockpicks alarmed doors. Enter through the back door with the Snap Gun, find the note with the safe code, and loot the safe. A good spot is Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City.

steps.t: Finish Chapter 3's Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs to unlock the Snap Gun.
Enter a jewelry store through the back door using the Snap Gun (not the kick).
Find the note with the safe code in the back room and loot the safe undetected.

claims.t: Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs in Chapter 3 unlocks the Snap Gun for silent lockpicking.
The Snap Gun stays in your inventory permanently; you do not need to equip it.
Kicking the back door triggers the alarm; the Snap Gun is the stealth approach.
Enter the back room, find the note with the safe code, and loot the safe.
Jewelry stores are marked automatically in unfogged map areas with a green icon.
A good location is Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City.
KeenGamer: rob a jewelry store without triggering detection.
gamemapa: rob a jewelry store undetected (needs the Snap Gun from Chapter 3).
Both PowerPyx and games.gg name Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds as a suitable target.

disputes.topic: How do you rob a jewelry store undetected?
disputes.a: PowerPyx and gamemapa: use the Snap Gun from Chapter 3’s Yasmani’s Jewelry Jobs for a silent entry.
disputes.b: KeenGamer gives no method — just rob a jewelry store without triggering detection.
disputes.call: Use the Snap Gun through the back door; it is the only published stealth method.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob any five bank vaults and escape. First finish the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is… — it introduces vault robberies with your first vault. After that, pay Yasmani $10,000 for security-van tips (after his earlier Payday Loan jobs) and follow the vans to the banks. All eight vaults are needed for 100%, so this pops on the way.

steps.t: Finish the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is… for the first vault.
Pay Yasmani $10,000 for security-van tips, follow a van to a bank, and rob the vault while it is open.
Bring your partner and hand off a cash bag (hold Right) — you cannot carry it all.
Escape the 4-star heat on a fast motorcycle, then switch vehicles to become unrecognisable.

claims.t: Any five bank vaults count; there are eight large bank jobs in total.
All eight vaults are required for the 100% checklist.
The Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is… introduces bank vault robberies.
In the mission you tail a security van, then a guard carries a briefcase into the bank and the vault opens.
You must bring your partner — you cannot carry all the cash yourself.
After the mission, Yasmani sells security-van tips for $10,000 (after his two Payday Loan robberies).
Robbing a bank vault instantly gives a 4-star wanted level.
A single bank vault pays up to $205,000 — the best endgame money.
Robbed vaults are shown when you scroll over their map icon.
KeenGamer confirms bank vaults are 8 of 8 for 100%.
games.gg notes bank vault robberies trigger a 4-star Wanted Level, so vault progress overlaps with Hot Together.

disputes.topic: What grade is Maximum Withdrawal?
disputes.a: The official list (Exophase / PSNProfiles): Silver.
disputes.b: Push Square’s guide lists it as Bronze.
disputes.call: Silver — the official list rules; Push Square’s grade is a slip.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape the heat. It pops automatically in the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is… — robbing the bank vault there counts as robbing an armored truck. Earlier route: block a truck near a bank, plant a sticky bomb on its back door, blow it, and escape the red heat radius.

steps.t: Easiest: finish the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is… — the vault robbery counts.
Earlier route: block an armored truck near a bank, sticky-bomb its back door and blow it open.
Escape the red heat radius (or use a Pay 'n' Spray) for the pop.

claims.t: The trophy unlocks automatically in the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is….
Robbing the vault of a large bank in that mission counts as robbing an armored truck.
KeenGamer lists it as a standalone robbery: rob an armored truck and escape.
Earlier method: block an armored truck driving near banks in Vice City.
Plant a sticky bomb on the truck's back door and blow it up.
The trophy unlocks only after escaping the red heat radius.
Sticky bombs are found in the back of Yasmani's shop after doing his quests.
Yasmani is unlocked as a fence from Chapter 3's Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs.
All eight large bank jobs are required for 100%, so this pops automatically.

disputes.topic: Does a bank vault robbery count as an armored truck robbery?
disputes.a: PowerPyx: yes — robbing the vault in That's Where The Money Is… automatically counts as robbing an armored truck.
disputes.b: KeenGamer lists A Classic Blitz Play as its own robbery, with no mention of the vault counting.
disputes.call: Use the mission route if you are already doing vaults; the standalone sticky-bomb route works from Chapter 3 onward and is confirmed by PowerPyx.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida — fully unfog the whole map. Fastest way is by plane: fly over every area still covered in black fog until the entire map is visible.

steps.t: Get a plane and fly over every fogged area of the map.
Keep flying until no black fog remains anywhere on the map.

claims.t: The trophy needs the whole map unfogged.
Best done with a plane, flying over all fogged areas.
PowerPyx links a guide to unfogging the map fast with the best plane.
gamemapa: clear the fog from the entire Leonida map.
KeenGamer: explore all of Leonida and uncover the complete map.
Exploring also marks activities and robbery targets on the map as areas unfog.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation belonging to each of the nine gangs. There are 39 operations in total and all 39 are needed for 100%, so this pops on the way. Operations are marked with yellow icons when you go near them; track each gang under Progress > Gangs.

steps.t: Rob illegal operations (yellow map icons) until one per gang is done.
Track each gang under Progress > Gangs — it shows how many of their operations you robbed.
Keep going to all 39 for the 100% checklist.

claims.t: There are nine gangs and 39 illegal gang operations.
Only one operation per gang is needed for this trophy.
All 39 operations are required for the 100% checklist.
Operations are marked by yellow icons on the map when you go near them.
Many operations are marked automatically from story progress.
Progress is tracked under Progress > Gangs, per gang.
PowerPyx links a guide to all illegal gang operation locations.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED — no source has found the trigger yet. The description says to enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. PowerPyx lists this trophy as currently unknown, KeenGamer says the exact trigger is still being confirmed, and gamemapa counts it among the five hidden trophies still unsolved. Do not chase guesses; check back after the guides update.

steps.t: No confirmed method exists yet — do not follow unverified guesses.
The description points to a cocktail with an Ocean Beach view; the trigger is unknown.

claims.t: PowerPyx: this trophy is currently unknown.
KeenGamer: exact trigger still being confirmed.
gamemapa lists it among the five hidden trophies still unsolved.
The description names a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
No source as of 21 Nov 2026 has published a confirmed method.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED — no source has found the trigger yet. The description says to smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. PowerPyx lists this trophy as currently unknown, KeenGamer says the exact method is still unconfirmed, and gamemapa counts it among the five hidden trophies still unsolved.

steps.t: No confirmed method exists yet — do not follow unverified guesses.
The description points to smashing out of a vehicle showroom; the trigger is unknown.

claims.t: PowerPyx: this trophy is currently unknown.
KeenGamer: exact method still unconfirmed.
gamemapa lists it among the five hidden trophies still unsolved.
The description names smashing out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
No source as of 21 Nov 2026 has published a confirmed method.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Steal all three key valuables at Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn — one of the gang operations — and escape the police. You go there during the Chapter 2 optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling. Take the luxury watch (south-east office), the Gutterball Moreland 850 shotgun (north-east table) and the safe (north-east hallway, sticky bombs). The trophy pops after you escape, not when you grab the third item — and you do not need all three in one visit.

steps.t: Go to Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn (Chapter 2 optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling).
Buy sticky bombs at an Ammu-Nation first — you need them for the safe.
Take the luxury watch (south-east office), the Gutterball Moreland 850 (north-east table), and blow the safe (north-east hallway).
Escape the police — the trophy pops after the escape, not on the third item.

claims.t: Kingpin Bowling is one of the gang operations, in Port Gellhorn.
You go there during the Chapter 2 optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling.
Three key valuables: a luxury watch (south-east office), the Gutterball Moreland 850 shotgun (north-east table), and the safe (north-east hallway).
The safe must be blown open with sticky bombs.
The trophy unlocks after you escape the police, not when you pick up the third item.
Killing the enemies is not necessary for the trophy.
You do not need all three valuables in one visit — the robbery icon respawns and you can return for the rest.
KeenGamer: steal the three key valuables at Kolt & Associates' bowling alley and escape.
gamemapa: take all three key valuables from Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn and lose the police.
games.gg: previously collected valuables still count if you return during a later robbery.

disputes.topic: Do the three valuables need one visit?
disputes.a: PowerPyx: no — you do not need all three in one go; the robbery icon respawns and you can return for the rest.
disputes.b: KeenGamer describes it as one job: steal the three key valuables and escape.
disputes.call: PowerPyx’s return-visit rule is the safer read; the icon respawns if you leave one behind.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Reach maximum Strength with both Jason and Lucia at the same time. Only possible after Chapter 2's Coffee Break, when you can switch characters. Work out at fitness clubs together — while one character trains, the other trains automatically, so progress doubles. Check Strength under Touchpad > Jason & Lucia.

steps.t: After Chapter 2's Coffee Break, bring both characters to a fitness club together.
Work out with one character — the other trains automatically at the same time.
Keep going until both show maximum Strength.

claims.t: Maximum Strength is needed with both Jason and Lucia at the same time.
Only possible after Chapter 2's Coffee Break, when you can switch between both characters.
Strength is raised by working out; buy a membership at a fitness club.
While one character works out, the other automatically completes their training too.
Always go together — call your partner with hold Right + Triangle.
Check Strength under Touchpad > Jason & Lucia > select character > Strength (heart icon).
Fitness clubs are found by filtering the map for Activities (dumbbell icon); there are many across Vice City.
You can also work out at home after the story.
gamemapa: max out Strength for Jason and Lucia at the same time.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that affect your Criminal Profile. It happens passively: every robbery and enemy encounter counts. Turn on Criminal Profile notifications (Settings > UI > HUD Notifications > Criminal Profile = On) so you see the demon face whenever an action counts. If you are still short at the end, it can be farmed by running over civilians and cops — but watch your profile: Psycho and Irredeemable make cops shoot on sight.

steps.t: Turn on Criminal Profile notifications in Settings > UI > HUD Notifications.
Play normally — robberies and enemy encounters count toward the 500.
Check progress by clicking the trophy in the trophy list.
If short at the end, farm it by running over civilians and cops with a car.

claims.t: 500 actions affecting your Criminal Profile are required.
Progress (how many of 500) is shown by clicking the trophy in the trophy list.
Turn on Criminal Profile notifications in Settings > UI > HUD Notifications > Criminal Profile = On.
A demon face appears on the right of the screen whenever an action affects your reputation.
Profiles: Professional (stealthy objectives, destroying evidence, clean escapes), Hardened (incapacitating without killing), Violent (killing enemies and civilians).
Psycho comes from killing large numbers of cops and civilians or driving over gravestones.
Irredeemable is permanent if you keep using excessive violence — avoid it, as cops get more aggressive.
Every robbery and enemy encounter counts, so it usually happens passively.
If still short, farm it by running over civilians and cops with a car.
Cops are more likely to shoot on sight at Psycho or Irredeemable profile.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 in Marked Bills through your contacts (fences). First finish the Chapter 3 mission Credit Check, which unlocks the Dye Pack Jammer for laundering marked bills. Then rob banks and Payday Loans and bring the bills to a fence — Yasmani in Vice City pays the most. The total counts across all robberies; bank vaults pay up to $205,000 in one robbery.

steps.t: Finish the Chapter 3 mission Credit Check (meet Raul's Crew) to unlock the Dye Pack Jammer.
Rob banks and Payday Loans for marked bills.
Bring the bills to a fence — Yasmani in Vice City pays the most — until $250,000 is laundered.

claims.t: A cumulative $250,000 in marked bills must be laundered; it does not need to be at once.
The Dye Pack Jammer is unlocked by finishing the Chapter 3 mission Credit Check (Meet Raul's Crew).
Marked bills come from robbing banks and Payday Loans.
Bills are brought to a fence; Yasmani in Vice City pays the most.
Bank vaults pay up to $205,000 in a single robbery.
Bank vaults are only unlocked after the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is….
This comes naturally while doing all robberies for the 100% checklist.
For 100% completion, $250,000 in marked bills must be fenced.
KeenGamer: launder a cumulative $250,000 in Marked Bills through contacts.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 in total across all types of shops. The fastest route is guns, car mods and tattoos — the most expensive items. Any shop spending counts, and it adds up naturally while gearing up for other trophies.

steps.t: Spend $100,000 in total across any shops.
Fastest: guns at Ammu-Nation, car mods at Mod Shops, and tattoos.

claims.t: A total of $100,000 must be spent across all types of shops.

Shop types include 24 Ammu-Nations, 14 Mod Shops, 67 clothing stores and 11 tattoo studios.
Also counted: 19 Pay 'n' Sprays, 17 footwear stores, 18 hair & beauty salons, 15 electronics stores.
Spending adds up naturally while gearing up for other trophies.
KeenGamer: spend a total of $100,000 across shops.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy all eight purchasable garages. They cost $160,000 in total and are bought through the Vice City Real Estate app, which is installed after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver. The four story garages do not count. Robberies — especially the higher-value ones in Chapters 3–4 — are the quick way to fund them.

steps.t: Finish the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver to get the Vice City Real Estate app.
Buy all eight purchasable garages through the phone app ($160,000 total).
Fund them with robberies — higher-value ones unlock in Chapters 3–4.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register ten vehicles in the Scooter Bros app. The app is installed after the Chapter 2 mission Moses. Drive stolen vehicles to Moses in Port Gellhorn and choose Respray then Register in his garage. You need enough garages first (see Little Boxes) — each garage adds parking spots. Cheap low-end cars and bikes keep the cost down.

steps.t: Finish the Chapter 2 mission Moses to get the Scooter Bros app.
Buy enough garages first — each adds parking spots for registered vehicles.
Drive stolen vehicles to Moses in Port Gellhorn, then Respray and Register.
Register ten vehicles; use cheap low-end cars and bikes to keep costs down.

claims.t: Ten vehicles must be registered through the Scooter Bros app.

Registered vehicles can be delivered to your location wherever you are.

Registering vehicles costs money; cheap low-end cars and bikes keep expenses low.
